zh: 每个回文子串都有唯一的中心（某个字符，或两个相邻字符之间）；从同一中心扩展出的最长回文比该中心的其他回文都长。
枚举全部 2n−1 个奇偶中心，各自向两侧扩展到不能再扩，只把每个中心的最长回文当作候选；长度不足 2 的候选直接忽略。
对中心 middle（0..2n−2），left=middle/2，right=left+middle%2，两端字符相等就同时外扩；候选为 s[left+1..right−1]；若长度 ≥2 且比当前答案更长，或等长且字典序更小，就更新答案；最后答案为空输出 None。
en: Every palindromic substring has a unique center (a character or the gap between two neighbours), and the longest palindrome grown from a center beats every other palindrome with that center.
Enumerate all 2n - 1 odd and even centers, expand each as far as possible, and only treat each center's longest palindrome as a candidate; ignore candidates shorter than 2.

For center middle in 0..2n - 2 set left = middle / 2 and right = left + middle % 2, and widen both ends while the characters match; the candidate is s[left + 1 .. right - 1]; if its length is at least 2 and it is longer than the current answer, or equally long and lexicographically smaller, take it; print None if the answer stays empty.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Enumerate both kinds of palindrome centers, odd and even, expand each until it can no longer grow, and compare only the longest candidate from each center.

## Proof of correctness

Every palindrome has a unique center. A non-maximal palindrome with the same center can never be better than the longest one at that center, so comparing only each center's longest candidate does not miss the global optimum; among equal lengths, the lexicographically smaller string is chosen explicitly.

## Complexity

O(n²) time; candidate slices need at most O(n) auxiliary space.
